table_creation_sql: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE slices.with_context; CREATE PERFETTO TABLE rt_device AS SELECT * FROM thread_slice WHERE category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') AND dur>=0

CREATE PERFETTO TABLE rt_link AS SELECT DISTINCT d.id device_id,h.id host_id,h.ts host_ts,h.dur host_dur,h.name host_name,h.utid host_utid FROM rt_device d JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=d.id JOIN thread_slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out WHERE h.category IN ('cuda_runtime','cuda_driver')

CREATE PERFETTO TABLE rt_regions AS WITH m AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ts) micro FROM thread_slice WHERE name GLOB 'task.profile_update.*.microbatch.rank*'), d AS (SELECT s.*,m.micro,CASE WHEN s.utid=m.utid THEN 'forward' ELSE 'SAC_recompute' END phase FROM thread_slice s JOIN m ON s.ts>=m.ts AND s.ts<m.ts+m.dur WHERE s.name='hybridep::dispatch') SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY micro,phase ORDER BY ts) ordinal FROM d

metadata_creation_sql.control: CREATE PERFETTO TABLE rt_finalmeta AS WITH bounds AS (SELECT r.*, (SELECT min(s.ts) FROM thread_slice s WHERE s.utid=r.utid AND s.ts>=r.ts AND s.ts<r.ts+r.dur AND s.name='aten::ge') lo,(SELECT min(l.host_ts) FROM rt_link l JOIN rt_device d ON d.id=l.device_id WHERE l.host_utid=r.utid AND l.host_ts>=r.ts AND l.host_ts<r.ts+r.dur AND d.name='_rowwise_1d_quantize_kernel') quant_launch FROM rt_regions r) SELECT r.*,r.id meta_id,(SELECT max(s.ts+s.dur) FROM thread_slice s WHERE s.utid=r.utid AND s.ts>=r.lo AND s.ts<r.quant_launch AND s.name='aten::view') hi FROM bounds r
metadata_creation_sql.routing: CREATE PERFETTO TABLE rt_finalmeta AS SELECT r.*,s.id meta_id,s.ts lo,s.ts+s.dur hi FROM rt_regions r JOIN thread_slice s ON s.utid=r.utid AND s.ts>=r.ts AND s.ts<r.ts+r.dur AND s.name='four_fusion::routing_metadata_cuda'
